item.title: Part Two Of Wahler Collection Nears $1.5 Million At Crocker Farm
item.description: SPARKS, MD. — The late renowned collector Carole Carpenter Wahler was scholarly and passionate when it came to collecting American stoneware and redware, most of which were Southern examples. Displays of beautiful and historically significant pieces filled her home and often were accompanied by copious notes of her research into these objects. The post Part Two Of Wahler Collection Nears $1.5 Million At Crocker Farm first appeared on Antiques And The Arts Weekly.
